subject: CODE preview needs original card portrait props for browser QA
body: CODE correcting PartyTray to original avatarForCard art. Existing turning-ravine-preview.jsx passes cards=[] and no avatarForCard, so cannot establish original portrait acceptance. Please provide preview props PRIMARY_CARDS and original NFO_CHARACTER_ART/NFO_CARD_ART mapping (same as App), refreshed separate disposable preview after source stable. Final build/shared outputs stay yours; original saves unchanged. CODE will make isolated browser frame QA fixture in own new paths if no refreshed mission preview is ready.
